I understand Zones C and D are currently clear and available for temporary staging. Before I authorize a temporary staging plan, I want to make sure we go through our standard warehouse review process — maintenance, EHS, and logistics all need to weigh in. Let's hear from each of those areas so we can get this resolved safely and efficiently. Who wants to start?
